interpretation: Element labels of one curated reference chain transferred to Rfam consensus positions through the validated residue mapping. They are not independent observations of helices or loops in each RNA instance.
transfer_method: reference unit id -> (pdb_id, label_asym_id, label_seq_id) by author number + insertion code -> rfam_consensus_pos of the reference chain mapping (rna_explorer mapping pipeline)

instance_transfer.source: BGSU correspondence/nucleotide_annotation per chain (labels transferred by BGSU)
